items.question: By what numerical scope are certain beings said to be tormented within womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified.
That count extends over thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings are described as tormented in that setting.
items.inference: Torment is said to occur to beings across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
